entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: An initiate and leader of the Tah crop on Amonkhet, later Hazoret's loyal lieutenant.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: Djeru's former best friend who appeals to Hazoret and fights alongside him.

entities.name: Nakht
entities.description: Djeru and Samut's friend, who died outside the Hekma.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: A God of Amonkhet whose Trial of Ambition Djeru survived.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker whose bumbling actions occurred during the Trial of Ambition.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: God of Amonkhet who wields a flaming spear and becomes protector of the survivors.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker group forced by the Gods to fight the Trial of Zeal.

entities.name: Hapatra
entities.description: Survivor of Amonkhet who is delegated the job of protecting and evacuating survivors.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: A God of Amonkhet who dies in the attacks.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: A God of Amonkhet who dies in the attacks.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: A God of Amonkhet who dies in the attacks.

entities.name: Scorpion God
entities.description: A God who fought Hazoret in the damaged city.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: City on Amonkhet where the Phyrexians are fought.

entities.name: Scarab God
entities.description: Insect god who engages the Phyrexians at Naktamun with undead hordes.

entities.name: Locust God
entities.description: Insect god who engages the Phyrexians at Naktamun.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders of Amonkhet whose veins hold glistening oil.

events.summary: Djeru, once best friends with Samut and Nakht, becomes a devout follower of the Gods and estranged from Samut after Nakht's death.
events.quote: After the death of Nakht outside the Hekma , he became a devout follower of the Gods and estranged from Samut.

events.summary: Djeru survives Bontu's Trial of Ambition.
events.quote: Djeru survived Bontu 's Trial of Ambition , despite the bumbling actions of Gideon Jura .

events.summary: Samut appeals to Hazoret, and she and the Gatewatch are forced to fight the Trial of Zeal against Djeru.
events.quote: Samut appealed to Hazoret to stop Djeru from taking the last Trial.

events.summary: Samut joins forces with Djeru and prevents his death with Hazoret's spear, though he does not appreciate it.
events.quote: In a surprise move Samut managed to join forces with Djeru, convincing him to pray for her life to Hazoret.

events.summary: Djeru, Samut and Hapatra witness the deaths of Rhonas, Kefnet and Oketra.
events.quote: Together with Hapatra , they witnessed the death of Rhonas , Kefnet , and Oketra .

events.summary: Hazoret commands them to protect survivors; Djeru and Samut return and save Hazoret from the Scorpion God.
events.quote: they returned to the damaged city and were able to save Hazoret from her fight with the Scorpion God .

events.summary: Survivors hide from the Phyrexian invasion in vain, then plan a counterattack relying on Hazoret with Djeru as lieutenant.
events.quote: with Djeru as her loyal lieutenant.

events.summary: At Naktamun the survivors find the Scarab God and Locust God already fighting the invaders.
events.quote: they found the Scarab God and Locust God already there, engaged with the invaders.

events.summary: Hazoret ignites the Phyrexians' oil and Djeru leads elite fighters to dismember them; the insect gods then depart.
events.quote: Djeru led a crop of elite fighters to dismember them, making sure they were out of the picture for good.

relations.quote: with Djeru as her loyal lieutenant.

relations.note: former best friends, joined forces again
relations.quote: Djeru joined forces with Samut when the attacks began.
